about.text: A Pontic Greek cheese, flavoured with herbs, smoked and matured slowly for at least a year. Its name is said to mean 'high mountains', and it is made today in Kilkis in Central Macedonia.

sources.text: Milk, herbs, smoking, one-year maturing and Kilkis; Pontic cheeses famed mainly in Kilkis, Veria, Katerini and Ptolemaida.
